title: Publish seven-unit AOCE submission and curated execution evidence
head: feat/submission-ci
body:
This change adds the complete U1–U7 submission alongside the isolated PortalLite source. It includes 17 required deliverables, synthetic source packets, sanitized local run/assertion/cleanup screenshots and actual Codex CLI benchmark outputs.

Raw credentials, auth state, grants, traces, CLI event streams and stderr are excluded. Local validation: TypeScript succeeds; controller regression 15/15; smoke discovery selects exactly F01/F02/F03; publication/history scan reports no known secrets.

GitHub Actions PR lane runs locked install, typecheck, fixture regression and discovery with exported static evidence. A manual hosted browser smoke will follow on main before enabling the daily schedule. Actual model monetary cost remains UNKNOWN; synthetic fixtures are not presented as live app passes.
